signatures.description: Implement a terminal text layout engine that segments input into extended grapheme clusters (combining marks, ZWJ emoji sequences, regional-indicator pairs, variation selectors), assigns each cluster a display width honoring East Asian Width plus ambiguity and zero-width rules, and reflows to a fixed column budget without ever splitting a cluster. It must also handle bidi runs and soft-hyphen break opportunities so every emitted row consumes at most the budget, and it must expose a stable inverse map from each rendered row offset back to a source byte index.
